done_when: Set-Location to a path outside the roots returns an error and aborts the block.
need: The bridge enforces cwd restrictions on the AIRUN header (cwd=...), but a manual 'Set-Location C:\Windows' inside the block succeeds and allows reading/writing outside the allowed roots. Proof: Result #45. Fix: The agent should block Set-Location to paths outside the allowed roots, or run the script in a locked-down container.
title: AIBridge CWD sandbox escape via Set-Location
